charts.title: Favourite School Subjects of Grade 10 Students in 2024
charts.model:
The bar chart shows the favourite school subjects of Grade 10 boys and girls in 2024. The school subjects were maths, science, English, Arabic and art. Overall, boys preferred maths, whereas girls preferred science.

Firstly, the most popular subject for boys was maths, with 40 students. This was followed by English (30), science (25) and Arabic (15). However, the least popular subject for boys was art, with only 5 students.

In contrast, the most popular subject for girls was science, with 40 students. This was followed by English (35), Arabic (25) and maths (20). However, the least popular subject for girls was art, with only 15 students.

To summarize, both boys and girls liked English. However, the biggest difference was in maths, where 40 boys chose it, whereas 20 girls did.

emails.task: You have started a new hobby. Write an email to your friend Maryam. In your email, write about:
bullets: what your hobby is and how you started it
why you enjoy it and your future plans
emails.model:
Dear Maryam,

Hello, how are you and your family? I hope you are very well. I am very happy to write to you. I am writing this email to tell you about my new hobby.

First, my new hobby is photography. I started it last summer when my father gave me a camera. Moreover, I take photos of nature every weekend.

Second, I enjoy photography because it helps me relax. For example, I feel calm when I take photos of the sea. Therefore, I want to join a photography club next year.

That's all I have for now. Please write and tell me your news. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best wishes,
Ali

emails.task: Imagine you are Salim/Salma. You noticed that most students in your school use plastic bags instead of reusable shopping bags. Write a formal email to your teacher asking him or her to give advice for students about using reusable shopping bags. You can include the following details:
bullets: why reusable shopping bags are important
how plastic bags harm the environment
how students can encourage others to use reusable bags
emails.model:
Dear Mr. Hilal,

I hope this email finds you in good health and high spirits. I am writing this email to ask you to give students some advice about using reusable shopping bags.

First, reusable bags are important because we can use them many times. However, plastic bags harm the environment, because they take hundreds of years to break down. Moreover, they kill many sea animals.

Second, students can encourage others by making posters and sharing short videos online. Moreover, they can bring reusable bags to school every day.

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to your response. Please let me know if you need any further information.

Yours sincerely,
Salim
